question: The work of expanding a gas (W):

options.opb: Equivalent to the heat associated with the process (Q).
options.opc: Against constant pressure it is calculated with W = -Pext ΔV.
options.opd: In a reversible isothermal process it is calculated with W = -nRTΔV.
options.ope: Equivalent to the internal energy change during the process (ΔU)
